primary_classification_metrics.uncertainty: 95% Wilson score interval computed separately for each binomial proportion

secondary_classification_summary.role: development objective / comparative summary, not a replacement for separate sensitivity and specificity

end_to_end_metrics.input_admissibility_fraction: ELIGIBLE_FOR_AFINO / all planned series in the stated plane
end_to_end_metrics.end_to_end_positive_recovery_fraction: selected synthetic-positive / all planned synthetic-positive series
end_to_end_metrics.end_to_end_null_selection_fraction: selected synthetic-null / all planned synthetic-null series

precision_ppv.reason: Synthetic positive/null prevalence is fixed by design and is not an observational prevalence estimate.

period_recovery.period_estimate_source: formal M1 center converted to seconds only for selected true positives with finite in-support estimate

all_eligible_positive_denominator.period_estimate_coverage_fraction: selected true-positive injections with finite recovered period / all eligible positive injections

error_distribution_summaries: 16th and 84th empirical percentiles for each error variable

candidate_vs_baseline_comparison.bootstrap_method: stratified paired nonparametric bootstrap of background_realization_id within split and designated n_samples×red_noise_alpha×qpp_fraction strata
candidate_vs_baseline_comparison.confidence_interval: two-sided percentile 95% interval; promotion rules use the corresponding lower confidence bound where prespecified

denominator_reporting.zero_exposure_stratum: report STRUCTURAL_NO_EXPOSURE; do not fabricate a rate

prohibited_interpretations: treating input inadmissibility as classifier non-selection
calling a non-selected formal M1 center a recovered period
